decisions.reason: The compact trommel is an evolution of an established, well-received model, so it costs little to keep within the core mobile screening range, and the option remains valuable despite limited recent evidence.
The AK flail shredder line was upgraded to EU Stage V engines, which signals a further commitment to a core product line whose value has largely been confirmed.
The mobile grinder line was promoted to its own page in 2019, which suggests growing prospects in the firm's core mobile business, and keeping this option open is cheap compared with abandoning it.
The stationary CERON pre-shredders are outside the mobile core and riskier to maintain, but reported plant installations show value is emerging, so the option is worth holding a while longer.
